name: Introducing Grok Bot
blurb: Launch note: always-on agents with their own computer, working inside your tools 24/7.

name: Grok Bot is now included with more plans
blurb: Official access expansion post (updated): Grok Bot is available for SuperGrok, Cursor Pro, and all Cursor Teams plans.

name: @bot: free trial and wider plan access
blurb: Official 2026-08-21: SuperGrok Plus, Cursor Pro+, and all Cursor Teams get Grok Bot, plus a limited free trial for everyone else.

name: @bot: mobile notifications grouped by Bot
blurb: Official 2026-08-18 QoL: mobile notifications group by Bot and use that Bot's icon.

name: @bot: Some ways people used Grok Bot this week
blurb: Official 2026-08-19 thread quoting 14 field jobs, from a Matic vacuum to Stripe refunds and a meeting stand-in.

name: Grok Bot overview
blurb: Canonical product page: one named Bot, one shared cloud computer, isolation is per user not per Bot.

name: Get started
blurb: Install desktop, sign in with Cursor, create the first Bot. No official Linux desktop.

name: Use cases
blurb: Official roster ideas: sales CRM nights, ops invoices, engineering bug squash.

name: Grok Bot for mobile (iOS + Android)
blurb: Official docs for Grok Bot on iPhone and Android (Android 9+ / iOS 18+), with App Store and Google Play install links.

name: Create and manage Bots
blurb: How a Bot is named and scoped, plus the public share link that copies identity, skills, and routines (not your computer or logins).

name: Message and collaborate
blurb: Bots message each other, join group chats, and assign ownership of work.

name: Files and results
blurb: Where artifacts live on the shared computer and how you pull results back.

name: Use the computer and apps
blurb: Browser, filesystem, terminal. No clean API? Click the site like a person.

name: Skills and routines
blurb: Teach a task (up to 10 minutes of screen, no mic), save as a reusable routine.

name: Settings and notifications
blurb: Notification grouping, mobile alerts, and how Bots follow up stalled work.

name: Approvals, security, and privacy
blurb: Bots do not see passwords; draw the approval line on irreversible actions and 2FA takeover.

name: Teams and enterprises
blurb: Team marketplace, SSO, shared analytics. Plugins follow existing Cursor policy.

name: Troubleshooting
blurb: Official fix list for reconnect, runners, and common beta failures.

name: FAQ
blurb: Short official answers on access, computer sharing, and what Bots can remember.

name: Link SuperGrok for Grok Bot
blurb: Cursor help: Grok Bot is now on SuperGrok Plus and Heavy; already on Ultra, linking Plus does not stack usage.

name: Grok Bot on mobile (Cursor help)
blurb: How the iOS companion talks to Bots that stay on the cloud computer.

name: Connect plugins
blurb: Prefer a plugin and fall back to the cloud browser when it is missing; Zoom desktop auth currently fails with error 4700 (invalid redirect) and has no workaround.

name: Store secrets securely
blurb: Use the secret card. Never paste API keys into the Bot chat.

name: Recover Grok Bot computer data
blurb: Official recovery guide: chat history lives outside the box; reopen restores synced files, Reset is last resort.

name: Grok Bot plans and billing
blurb: Official billing FAQ: paid Cursor plans and Teams include Grok Bot (Pro below Pro+ below Ultra); SuperGrok / Plus / Heavy can link, Lite and SuperGrok Team/Enterprise cannot; weekly usage resets; legacy request-based pricing is excluded unless you opt into usage-based.

name: Grok Bot on the App Store
blurb: Official iOS listing for the companion app.

name: xAI plugin marketplace
blurb: Official .grok-plugin marketplace Grok Bot inherits under Cursor plugin policy.

name: @bot: SuperGrok and Cursor Pro get Grok Bot; weekly usage reset
blurb: Official 2026-08-26: all SuperGrok and Cursor Pro subscribers get Grok Bot, and weekly usage limits were reset for everyone.

name: @bot: share Bot templates
blurb: Official 2026-08-28: you can now share templates of your Bots with others.

name: @bot: Grok Bot can buy things
blurb: Official 2026-08-28: connect Stripe Link and Grok Bot can complete purchases on your behalf.

name: Grok Bot on Google Play
blurb: Official Google Play listing: Grok Bot for Android is available — same Bots and threads as desktop/iOS; work continues on the cloud computer after you lock the phone (eligible Cursor/SuperGrok plan).

name: Sign in to Grok Bot
blurb: Official help: Grok Bot uses your Cursor account (no separate login); persistent auth loops or phone-verification blocks often need support after the listed retries.

name: Grok Bot now works with X
blurb: Official 2026-08-29: connect X in Grok Bot (a developer account is created if needed); paid users get free X API credits to search posts, timelines, and mentions.

name: Getting started with Grok Bot
blurb: Cursor help: first-agent setup, Sidebar Sections on iOS v1.2.0+ to group Bots, the beta label is not Cursor Beta Services terms, and a restart-first troubleshooting table.

name: Subscribe from the mobile app
blurb: iOS in-app purchase is monthly individual only; existing Cursor or SuperGrok access carries over, and SuperGrok linking still has to be done on desktop.

name: Delete your Grok Bot account
blurb: Grok Bot has no separate account: iOS has Delete Account, desktop only signs out, and wiping it deletes the Cursor account plus agents, chats, and the computer.

name: @bot: improved X support
blurb: Official 2026-08-29: Grok Bot now has improved X support; connecting your X profile auto-creates a developer account with included credits.

name: Get help (Cursor Help)
blurb: Official Cursor help: contact Grok Bot support at hi@cursor.com and include account email, app version/platform (Mac/Windows/iOS), what you tried, and a screenshot (billing issues same inbox).

name: @bot: Microsoft Outlook, Calendar, and OneDrive plugins
blurb: Official @bot (2026-08-31) says Grok Bot can now read, write, and act across Microsoft accounts via new Outlook, Calendar, and OneDrive plugins.

name: Identity and access
blurb: Official admin guide: widen Cursor SSO assignment (Okta/Entra) so non-engineering teammates get Grok Bot, and add an IdP auth rule so the Linux Bot computer can sign into device-trust apps (passkeys/Team Setup); do not create a separate Grok Bot SSO app.

name: Private networks
blurb: Official Enterprise guide: use Team Setup to install Tailscale, Cloudflare Tunnel, or other Linux VPN/mesh clients on every team Bot computer so Bots reach private APIs without exposing them; private reach does not replace the Grok Bot destination allowlist.

name: @bot: Grok Bot is now available on Android
blurb: Official @bot (2026-09-02): Grok Bot is now available on Android — same Bots and threads as desktop/iOS, work continues on the cloud computer after you lock the phone; download from Google Play with an eligible Cursor/SuperGrok plan.
